# gws persona: IT Administrator

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the IT Administrator persona: the only admin/security-oriented persona of this lot, with no equivalent in lot 31 — start the day reviewing pending IT requests with `+standup-report`, monitor suspicious login activity and audit logs, configure Drive sharing policies to enforce organizational security. Its golden rule: always `--dry-run` before bulk operations, and review `gws auth status` regularly to verify service account permissions. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); the cited `gws-gmail`, `gws-drive`, `gws-calendar` prerequisite skills come from the same repo but are not listed in this catalog; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
